uda.p: (1) The meaning of Apisadda., Asking. (2) Special consideration. (doesn't like that, Except that matter or status). (3) Connecting words, To full words. filling the words. Uda(na) [udaka does uda. Moga, sya.3.72.] Water. See - Udaka. Uda (pu) [u+dā+kvi] Knowledge, Wisdom.
a: (၁)အပိသဒ္ဒါ၏ အနက်၊ မေးခြင်း။(၂)အထူးကြံခြင်း။(ထိုသို့မဟုတ်၊ ထိုမှတစ်ပါး)၊(၃)ပုဒ်စပ်ခြင်း။ ပုဒ်ကို ပြည့်စေခြင်း၊ ပုဒ်ဖြည့်ခြင်း။ uda ဥဒ(န) [ဥဒက-ကို ဥဒ-ပြု။ မောဂ်၊ သျ။၃။၇၂။] ရေ။ ဥဒက-ကြည့်။ uda ဥဒ(ပု) [ဥ+ဒါ+ကွိ] ပညာ၊ဉာဏ်။

P: Uda，<sup>2</sup> （°-） [Vedic udan （nt．），also later uda （but only °-），commonly udaka，q．v．] water，wave．In cpds．sometimes the older form udan° is preserved （like udañjala，udaññavant），but generally it has been substituted by the later uda° （see under udakaccha，udakanti，udakumbha，udapatta，udapāna，udabindu）．（Page 132）

Uda，1 （indecl．） [Sk．uta & u，with Lat．aut （or），Gr．au（_ti （again），au）taρ （but，or），Goth．auk = Ger．auch to pron．base ava° yonder，cp．ava II．] disjunctive part．“or”； either singly，as at Sn．455，955，1090； J．V，478 （v．l．udāhu）； Nd1 445 （expld． as “padasandhi” with same formula as iti，q．v．）； Pv．II，1216 （kāyena uda cetasā）； or combd． with other synonymous particles，as uda vā at Sn．193，842，1075； It．82 = 117 （caraṁ vā yadi vā tiṭṭhaṁ nisinno uda vā sayaṁ walking or standing，sitting or lying down）； KhA 191．-- See also udāhu．（Page 132）
U: UDA：udaka [nt] nước （uống） --kāka [m] một loại còng cọc nhỏ --dhārā [f] một dòng nước --phusita，--bindu [nt] một nhểu nước --manika [m] lu lớn đựng nước --sāṭikā [f] áo choàng tắm

(pāḷiyaṃ kevalo uda-saddo na diṭṭha- pubbo . . . , Sadd 237, 20 ); [Ja l 296, 4 udasmiṃ read with C e udakasmiṃ; cf. CPD l anto 2 c α "°-uda- (ka)smiṃ"]; ifc. appoda (-vaṇṇa), nāga-vittoda (?, Ja V 6, 2*,22' ), nīloda (Vl 172, 7*,12' ), pādoda (Khuddas XXX 5); cpds. see °-kumbha, °-kesa (?), °-dhi, °-patta, °-pāna, °-bindu, °-hāra(ka), °-hārī, °-hāriyā; cf . udañjala (?), udaññava(nt).
